summary: The Course module provides CRUD operations, validation, and business rule logic for managing course records and lists in the HSPnet system. It includes workflows for creating, updating, deleting, and searching courses, as well as managing course-related attributes, mappings to departments/agencies, and configurable properties relevant to student activities, instructor ratios, and reporting.
purpose: To enable structured management of course entities, their attributes, business rules, and workflows, supporting department/agency program operations, student activity policies, and reporting requirements in an educational placement system.

workflows.name: Course CRUD
steps: Create/Add Course: Validates fields, applies business rules, and performs insertion via stored procedure.
Update Course: Validates fields, applies business rules, updates record via stored procedure.
Delete Course: Removes course record via stored procedure.
Reactivate Course: Sets course as active via stored procedure.

workflows.name: Course Search and List
steps: Get Courses by Department/Agency/Cohort/Staff: Sets parameters and runs procedure to retrieve course list.
Populate filtered course lists for UI contexts (e.g., filtering by cohort or program).
Cache course details for efficient retrieval during screen refresh.

workflows.name: Apply Business Rules
steps: On save/update, enforce cutoff day policies if student activities are not allowed.
Ensure required fields (Name, ShortName, DefaultTypeCodeID, DurationHours) are present and valid.

workflows.name: Course Validations
steps: Validate InstructorStudentRatio on update; must start with '1' and have at least 3 characters.
Auto-calculate DurationHours if missing, from DurationShifts and ShiftLength.

workflows.name: Update ASM Fields
steps: Allows updating max student PR selections, duplicate PRs, ranking, and other student activity options.

business_rules: Student activities cutoff days must be -1 if activities are not allowed; otherwise, must be >= -1.
Course Name and ShortName are mandatory.
DurationHours required; can be derived from DurationShifts and ShiftLength if missing.
InstructorStudentRatio must start with '1' and be at least 3 characters.
Business rules applied before saving; incomplete fields trigger validation errors.
QES/RA PR courses default to 'Unknown' for name if not specified.
validations: DurationHours must not be zero (try to calculate if missing).
conditions: If DurationHours is zero, calculate from DurationShifts and ShiftLength
system_behavior: Procedures cache course details to reduce redundant database calls.
Some course lists are filtered based on input parameters (DepartmentID, AgencyID, CohortID, etc).
Course CRUD operations performed via stored procedures.
Some fields and business rules enforced on client side for validation.
dependencies: Relies on HSPnetSession for database operations and context.
Courses linked to Departments, Agencies, and Cohorts.
ASM fields depend on student activity settings and site/service configurations.
exceptions: Validation errors for missing or invalid fields upon create/update.
